what_this_is: Products held out of PlotNua's public product data because following PlotNua's link to them is not currently safe for a homeowner. One row per Atlas product id, enumerated by hand. Read by .github/scripts/generate_garden_room_universe.py (Blocker G: the product is excluded from the garden-room universe) and by .github/scripts/generate_recognition_pool.py (the product keeps its identity, but its outbound link is withheld). atlas-tools/apply-safety-hold.py applies the same rule to the committed files.
what_this_is_not: Not a quality filter, not a judgement of the supplier or its products, and not a way to change a published figure. A hold is about the safety of the LINK, on evidence, and is lifted when that evidence no longer holds.
adding_or_removing: Founder decision only. Adding a row lowers the garden-room universe count; removing one raises it. Say which and why in the commit.
